papers.title: Direct 3D bioprinting of prevascularized tissue constructs with complex microarchitecture
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of NanoEngineering, University of California, San Diego, La Jolla, CA, 92093, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Shaochen Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of NanoEngineering, University of California, San Diego, La Jolla, CA, 92093, USA; Department of Bioengineering, University of California, San Diego, La Jolla, CA, 92093, USA; Materials Science and Engineering Program, University of California, San Diego, La Jolla, CA, 92093, USA. Electronic address: chen168@eng.ucsd.edu

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文描述了直接3D生物打印构建预血管化组织的方法，但未涉及任何AI技术，与‘AI for Bioprinting’方向相关性低。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage; it is a pure bioprinting technique without intelligent control or prediction.

summary_zh.motivation: 构建具有复杂微结构的预血管化组织是生物打印的挑战。
summary_zh.method: 使用直接3D生物打印技术制造预血管化组织构建物。
summary_zh.result: 成功打印出具有微血管网络的复杂组织构建物。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞培养验证了构建物的细胞活性和血管形成。

summary_en.motivation: The challenge of fabricating prevascularized tissue constructs with complex microarchitecture motivates this study.
summary_en.method: A direct 3D bioprinting approach is employed to manufacture prevascularized tissue constructs.
summary_en.result: Complex tissue constructs with microvascular networks are successfully printed.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture confirms cell viability and vascular formation in the printed constructs.

papers.title: Additive manufacturing of cardiovascular CoCr stents by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Via La Masa 1, 20156 Milan, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Ali Gökhan Demir
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Via La Masa 1, 20156 Milan, Italy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及心血管支架的增材制造，与髋关节植入物的应力屏蔽和骨整合方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, bone-implant interface, porous structures for osseointegration, or hip implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现CoCr心血管支架的激光选区熔化制造。
summary_zh.method: 优化SLM工艺参数制备CoCr支架。
summary_zh.result: 成功制造出具有良好力学性能的支架。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证支架性能。

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate cardiovascular CoCr stents using selective laser melting with optimized process parameters.
summary_en.method: SLM process parameters were optimized to produce CoCr stents with desired mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: Stents were successfully manufactured with adequate mechanical performance for cardiovascular applications.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including compression and possibly fatigue was performed to validate stent properties.
